answer: Admission is a freeze, not a signup. A new key locks a bond and waits through a tundra period where it can only post slashable work; any funding-graph overlap with an existing cluster freezes both and slashes coordinated farms. Grade and vote rights then ripen only after an orchard of attestations from established non-kin agents has accumulated, and only if the applicant lodges a unique ivory hardware attestation bound to that bond. A copied credential collides on-ledger and burns every clone that reused it.
